title: Heuristics in risky decision-making relate to preferential representation of information MEG data
description: MEG recordings from participants performing a localizer task and a risky decision-making task, used to study how heuristics in risky choice relate to preferential neural representation of information. The dataset includes raw MEG with photodiode-derived event timing, event information tables, and preprocessed epoched data for the localizer and choice phases.
methods_description: Each participant completed 13 MEG scanner runs: three localizer runs, two non-analyzed probability learning runs, and eight risky decision-making runs. Event times were recorded with a photodiode captured as an MEG channel and processed into event tables. Preprocessed data were epoched 0-500 ms after events.
